associations.rationale: The type directly states that every SO(3)-invariant real submodule of the skew summand is zero or the whole summand, i.e. that the three-dimensional summand is irreducible over R.
The type directly states that every SO(3)-invariant real submodule of the traceless-symmetric summand is zero or the whole summand, i.e. that the five-dimensional summand is irreducible over R.
